name: personal-ai

personal-foundation.description: Personal global reasoning, research, document and collaboration skills.

web-engineering.description: React/Next and Node/NestJS web engineering, quality, browser tests and API integrations.

design-studio.description: Interface exploration, redesign, motion and HTML publishing.

research-documents.description: Evidence-based research, extraction and editable document creation.

marketing-growth.description: Positioning, campaigns, content, experimentation and growth operations.

engineering-operations.description: Architecture, data integrity, security, observability and release operations.

runtime_policy: Installation verifies Codex desktop, Codex CLI and Claude Code CLI without running a model or an upstream installer. Claude is supported as a CLI delegate only. Skill registration and Codex plugin export do not connect accounts or provision third-party runtimes.

delegation.strategy: Use available ChatGPT/Codex subagents by default. Use Claude Code selectively for a bounded independent perspective, specialist fit or explicit user preference. Codex retains orchestration and verification.
